notes.title: V0.8.77 - Civilians, Character Abilities, & Improved Guidance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39200570/67b84a80f405d864430b60897b020f16be9ac8be.png[/img]
In this update (v0.8.77) [b]Character Abilities[/b] have finally been made into effect. Operator "Drake Woods" & "Rex" have been made temporarily unlocked without criteria for playtesters. The recon drone has been made exclusive to Rex, with the exception of finding new [b]Drone Stations[/b] where any operator can launch and operate a drone. A new mechanic; [b]Airstrike Request[/b] has been added as a unique ability for Drake Woods. The experimental [b]Zipline Device[/b] have been made exclusive for Duchess.

Platforming have been made smoother with amenities such as coyote time, improved ladder movement & snapping, and jump from crouched position.

Players now have to be super careful minimizing collateral damage, with [b]Civilians[/b] added to Mission 2: Operation Sandcat. Killing a civilian will immediately result in mission failure.
[b]Precision shots > Spray 'n' Pray.[/b]

Mission 1: Arctic Strike has received improvements in regards to level design, accommodating the new playstyles depending on character, as well as guiding new players with improved labels, and a [b]new guidance mechanic;[/b] an arrow UI pointing players toward the direction of nearby key items & objectives. [b]Facility Maps[/b] have also been improved, with UI elements displaying objective locations (Primary and certain secondary objectives).

notes.title: NEW 2024 GAMEPLAY TRAILER!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Dfqq01R8tDc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Rushaug is leaving behind the project title "Project Emerald" and transforms into [b]"Feline Warfare"[/b]![/h2]
[i]Emerald[/i] was a project-name from the start, and in Rushaug's current state; [b]Feline Warfare[/b] reflects the game's theme and identity far more. After all, the game is about a world in conflict, inhabited by cats. Rushaug is becoming more and more a satirical depiction of human conflict throughout the last hundred years. Cats fighting over the colour of their flags, the patterns on their fur, political and societal systems.
Some people have been asking for updates, wondering about progress being made, and I am confident this trailer have been a clear indication to how far the game has come. I am very proud of this trailer, and it's been very gratifying for me to see my work finally showing.

On March 30th, the trailer surpassed [b]250 000 views[/b], [b]quarter of a million[/b] in just two weeks. This is a great milestone, thanks to everyone who have supported me throughout development! Exciting times ahead!



-

If you have not yet, join the Discord where I write dev-related posts more frequently!

notes.title: V0.8.74 - The "EMBER" Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=e0vRgLEhWeU;full][previewyoutube=e0vRgLEhWeU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]
New update is now live, with emphasis on player feedback; particularly from Spillexpo 2023 (Annual Norwegian Game Exhibition). These are the 4 most significant changes:

[olist]
[*]A [b]Weight Rating System[/b] is now in effect, determined by the player's loadout. All weapons have a specific rating, SMG typically "2", AR "3", and so on. Stamina duration is entirely determined by the combined rating of primary and secondary weapon carried.
[*]A significant change to the Alert Mode has been introduced; an [b]Enemy Ticket System[/b]. During alert mode, the enemy units will receive a limited pool of reinforcements, which when depleted cuts off their ability to respawn, and instantly end Alert Mode when last enemy in sector is eliminated. This is to combat the ever-lasting alert mode if player is not avoiding enemies for a long enough duration, giving the player an option to fight his/her way out of an alarm/detection.
[*]Contextual UI has been made clearer in several situations, most significantly for keycard doors, clearly indicating if player lacks an item, and the keycard doors has also been optimized.
[*][b]Mission Briefing Cutscenes[/b] have finally been added. (Players can only trigger the briefing for Mission 1 currently) [b]The Dialogue System have been revamped[/b] for the occasion. The text box has been shrunk to take up less space on the screen, and made more responsive by adapting it's height and position to the displayed text. The dialogue UI have received a visual overhaul, and been properly optimized.
[/olist]
 Full changelog with all other changes and improvements listed below!

notes.title: SPILLEXPO 2022 (Norway's Largest Game Exhibition)
notes.content:
This year's attendance at Spillexpo 2022 is complete! Many new impressions, even [b]NRK (Norway's National Channel)[/b] tried out Rushaug: Project Emerald, and conducted an interview! Huge thanks to my brother and dear friends for assisting me in setting up and tending the stand! I have exciting news for playtesters coming very soon!

notes.title: An Announcement
notes.content:
The release date was once again silently pushed, this time from [b]20th October 2021[/b] to [b]1st March 2022[/b]. This was caused by unfortunate circumstances.

In early September, I experienced multiple hemorrhages (bleedings) in my left lung, caused by my preexisting condition. I was quickly admitted to the hospital, and went through multiple procedures to locate the site in which the bleeds occurred in the lung, and treat it accordingly. Although the doctors were unable to identify the exact vessel causing the bleeding, the radiologists embolized an intercostal artery largely suspected in supplying blood to the hemorrhaging site. The procedure went fine without complications.
More than a month has passed since the hospitalization, and I have fortunately not coughed up any more blood since.

However, these circumstances had left me exhausted, and combined with some stressors in my personal life, I experienced a burnout. This is why I delayed the release, and took a break from development.

I'm sorry if this comes as disappointing for some, trust me, it is just as disappointing for me, if not more. I want the game to be released as soon as possible, but I will not compromise on quality. On a positive note, I can tell that I am feeling better and less exhausted than I did the following weeks after surgery, and I am back to working on the game. In the meantime, I will continue to update the demo for any new features or changes. I have some other exciting news I will share in a separate announcement.

Be well everyone!

notes.title: v0.8.42 - More Music & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]More music! [/h2]This update improved existing soundtracks while also adding a new one. Multiple crucial bugs have been fixed, and XBox Gamepad compatibility is improved and still being worked on.
